fields.label: The good stuff
fields.placeholder: Tell me a bit about the project, the deadline, and how you found me.

faq.a: Most full builds run 4 to 8 weeks. Smaller marketing sites and landing pages are usually 1 to 2 weeks from kickoff to live.

faq.q: Do you work with international clients?
faq.a: Always. I keep flexible hours and lean heavily on async-friendly workflows like Loom, Notion, and detailed PR descriptions.

faq.q: Can you join my existing team?
faq.a: Yes. I'm comfortable jumping into established codebases, following house style, and contributing as a senior engineer or tech lead.

faq.q: What about ongoing support after launch?
faq.a: Every engagement ends with a handover doc, a Loom walkthrough, and a 30-day support window included by default.
